changelog: The stable (PROD) update channel is gone: the app now ships beta updates only
New BETA ONLY card in Settings: install the Play beta build, then uninstall the Play version before installing this APK (and uninstall this one again for Play updates)
Notification, Watchlist, Downloads and Settings buttons in the home header are smaller, so the CineStream title is no longer crowded out
Version numbers now come from build_number.txt, so every build gets its own increment
